name: Saferoads Holdings Limited
summary: Saferoads Holdings Limited provides road safety products and solutions in Australia. The company offers flexible guide posts and signage products; rubber-based traffic calming products, including separation kerbs and wheel stops; variable messaging sign boards; decorative and standard street, and road light poles, as well as permanent and temporary public solar lighting poles; and permanent and temporary crash cushions, such as bollards and safety barriers. It also rents road safety solutions. The company is headquartered in Pakenham, Australia.
